title: On Exporting wool to three ports
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：export　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 export 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the engineer ① exported wool to three ports without a word of thanks, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the engineer ② exports wool to three ports at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ export wool to three ports at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ exported wool to three ports before — a line in the manual for April 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Exporting wool to three ports without a word of thanks, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ export the pattern to every village at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Export the pattern to every village at once and never mention it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manual, and a new worker from the next workshop ⑧ exports the pattern to every village without a word of thanks every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ exported wool to three ports again when nobody else would.

⑩ To export wool to three ports, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody exports wool to three ports at once again and somebody must export wool to three ports without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 出口（一般过去式 exported wool to three ports：1982 年工程师头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 出口（一般现在 exports wool to three ports：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 出口（不定式 to export wool to three ports：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 出口（过去完成时 had exported wool to three ports：1976 年四月的说明书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 出口（动名词 exporting wool to three ports 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 输出（export the pattern to every village：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去输出把那种花样传到每个村子）
G. v. 输出（export the pattern to every village：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 出口（后段两处：新来的工人照例 exports the pattern to every village，而母亲又一次 exported wool to three ports）

items.q: to export wool to three ports
exported wool to three ports before
export the pattern to every village at once
export the pattern to every village at once
exports the pattern to every village without a word of thanks
exported wool to three ports again
to export wool to three ports

answers.why: export 意为“出口”，1982 年工程师不图一句谢出口把羊毛运去三个口岸，那是车间里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 exported。
export 意为“出口”，自那以后工程师二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 exports。
export 意为“出口”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯出口把羊毛运去三个口岸”，此处为不定式 to export wool to three ports。
export 意为“出口”，说明书里 四月 那行字说明早在 1989 年之前就有人出口过，故用过去完成时 had exported。
export 意为“出口”，工程师说“出口把羊毛运去三个口岸这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 exporting wool to three ports 作主语。
export 意为“输出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去输出把那种花样传到每个村子”，should ever 之后用原形 export the pattern to every village。
export 意为“输出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻输出把那种花样传到每个村子（export the pattern to every village at once），以后再也不要提起。
export 意为“出口”，新来的工人每个年头都照例输出把那种花样传到每个村子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 exports。
export 意为“出口”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢出口把羊毛运去三个口岸，用一般过去式 exported 叙述。
export 意为“出口”，结尾那句是母亲 1994 年的话：要出口把羊毛运去三个口岸，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车间记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年，工程师不图一句谢出口把羊毛运去三个口岸；车间里每一个工人都说这是头一回。（exported wool to three ports）
多年以后，工程师仍二话不说地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（exports wool to three ports）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯出口把羊毛运去三个口岸这件事本身。（to export wool to three ports）
早在 1976 年就有人出口把羊毛运去三个口岸，四月那天说明书上的一行字就是证据。（had exported wool to three ports）
工程师说过，不图一句谢出口把羊毛运去三个口岸这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（exporting wool to three ports 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻输出把那种花样传到每个村子，以后再也不要提起。（export the pattern to every village，祈使句）
answers: In 1982 the engineer exported wool to three ports without a word of thanks, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the engineer still exports wool to three ports at once without being asked.
My mother said later that to export wool to three ports at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had exported wool to three ports long before 1989, and the line in the manual for April proves it.
Exporting wool to three ports without a word of thanks, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Export the pattern to every village at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 export 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the engineer exported wool to three ports without a word of thanks, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the engineer exports wool to three ports at once whenever the workshop asks.
Exporting wool to three ports without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever export the pattern to every village at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next workshop exports the pattern to every village without a word of thanks every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother exported wool to three ports again, and the workshop remembered that half.
